newsitem.title: INDIA: India to divest 5 pct in Indian Oil Corp.
newsitem.headline: India to divest 5 pct in Indian Oil Corp.

text.p: The Indian government has decided to divest five percent of its equity holding in the Indian Oil Corporation, an official statement said on Friday.
"These shares will be offered for sale in the secondary market through the GDR route as well as through an offer for sale in the domestic retail market," it said.
The government, after a competitive evaluation, has decided to appoint Credit Suisse-First Boston and Goldman Sachs as joint coordinators to the sale.

The domestic tranche of the equity sell-off will be managed by a consortium of four Indian merchant bankers, State Bank of India Capital Markets Ltd (SBI Caps), ICICI Securities, JM Financial and ENAM Financials.
